title: Python Programming | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Python Programming. Category: Development. Duration: 3 months. Description: An introduction to programming and the Python language, covering core programming concepts such as data structures, conditionals, loops, variables, and functions. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
